title: Speed up Intent story comparison frontend proof

intentCoverage.report:
## Intent Coverage

**Caught** for SEED-413#speed-story-comparison-frontend-proof at `ac1013fd6e1a297bf5916445b5a54eeedbe3e1de`. When a reviewer includes merged changes, the selected incoming file’s Proof still identifies the whole story’s measured landed build.

**Fault.** Removed the `!includesMerged &&` condition from `compare.isDefault` in `dashboard/src/useStoryComparison.ts:207`. The case used its published-completion fixture with a widened branch and measured landed build `9999999`. The fixtures and maintained assertions were untouched.

**Observation.** The focused maintained Chromium case passed before the fault. With the fault, the failure screenshot independently shows Include merged changes checked, the widened baseline of `8888888…`, Proof selected, and Landed `9999999` still listed. The whole-story note is absent above Test execution time history. The first failing assertion was the build in file Proof’s note at `dashboard/frontend-tests/intent/intent-story-compare-fixed.spec.ts:75`, which received `null` and expected `9999999`. This establishes detection on the file Proof path. The screenshot is retained at `/tmp/dough-compare-coverage.u820Zc/fault-proof.png`.

**Restoration.** After restoration, the edited source matched its saved bytes, the detached revision and clean Git status matched the baseline, and the same focused case passed again. Removed the disposable worktree.

**Next proof action.** Keep the maintained file Proof assertion. This check adds no follow-up proof work.

- **Test runtime.** 27.57 s total (measured), the sum of Vitest’s reported durations of 16.15 s for the baseline, 7.18 s for the fault, and 4.24 s for the restored run. Each run selected the same single Chromium case.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. The check had no separately measured human time.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. The tools provide no separate measure of active agent time.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 135729 ms (measured), from 1795430979000 to 1795431114729 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition: Keep the maintained assertion. The checked comparison guard and assertion are unchanged at 8b4a5afd023f8c83de2434e042ab6a334a62cc0b, where all 42 comparison-fixture cases passed. No follow-up for this observed path.
